main_text.p: ᾅΔης ᾰ ὁ orcus, sepulcrum, Satanas, Matth.16.

p.i: 18. pro ἀΐδης ᾰ ὁ (qua voce poëta utuntur) ab ἀΐδης ἐῤῤῆ obscurus, ex α priv. & ἰδεῖν. a.2. act.infin.videre. Th.ἀΐδω.

main_text.p: ᾅΑδηκέητος ᾰ ὁ ἡ non dubitans, certus, ex α priv. & Διαλελήσομαι haesito, dubito, discepto, Jac.3.17.
ᾅΑδιάλειπτος ᾰ ὁ ἡ non intermissus, indefinens, perpetuus a, Rom.9.2.
ᾅΑδιαφθορίας ἡ integritas, a nomine ἀδιάφθο-ρος ᾰ ὁ ἡ incorruptus. Th.φθείρω, Tit.2.17.
ᾅΑδικος ᾰ ὁ ἡ injustus. ex α priv. & δίκη jus, Luc.16.10.
ᾅΑδικέω ῶ injuria afficio cum accus. item laedo, Luc.10.19. F. ἀδικήσω. P. ἠδίκημαι. a.1. ἠδικήσα. praes.pass. ἀδικέομαι ὕπὸ injuriam patior. P.pass. ἠδικημαι. a.1.pass. ἠδικήθην.
ᾅΑδοκιμος ᾰ ὁ ἡ judicii expers, reprobus, rejectaneus, ineptus. ex α priv. & δοκιμος ᾰ ὁ ἡ probus. Th.δοκέω ῶ videor, censeo. item sum in aliqua existimatione, Rom.1.28.
ᾅΑδολος ᾰ ὁ ἡ sincerus. ex α & δόλος ᾰ ὁ fraus, 1.Pet.2.2.
ᾅΑδρότης ητος ἡ abundantia. Th.ἀδρὸς ὰ ὀν abundans, 2.Cor.8.20.

page.notes: The left-hand strip (partly cut off, from the facing page) is a fragment of marginal references and was not transcribed in full. Greek accents and breathings are approximate where the scan is faint; several Greek forms are uncertain and may be misread.
